payload.summary: The accounts for 2024/25: a General Fund underspend of £0.769m, 1.18%, and a Housing Revenue Account underspend of £8.300m, 10.17% — most of it because a government change meant a planned £10.045m contribution to building new social housing was no longer needed. Capital spending was £48.741m against £62.008m.
